answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best”—the right choice depends on your case, and directory ratings aren’t a guarantee of results. Based on the available listings, **Teresa Li** is one local option to consider: Avvo lists her as practicing personal injury in Pleasanton, with a 5.0 rating from 10 reviews. **Guy Ellery Louie** is another, listed at 4.9 from 77 reviews. Those are directory ratings, not an independent assessment of case outcomes.

Before hiring anyone, check their current license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch), and speak with two or three lawyers. Ask about experience with cases like yours, who will handle the work, fees and costs, and how they would approach your case. Many injury lawyers offer a free initial consultation.
